baseScanReturnNotice.summary: BaseScan was unable to update the public token page due to insufficient or inconsistent information. The notice listed common blockers: website accessibility or safety, unclear token/project information, placeholders, broken links, insufficient team transparency with supporting public profiles, and sender email not matching the project domain.
baseScanReturnNotice.mustNotClaim: Do not say BaseScan token profile is approved, published, accepted, or complete until BaseScan publishes the token profile.

currentEmailState.ownerActionRequired: Submit one clean BaseScan token profile update from support@gcagochina.com and keep private provider/DNS/inbound/outbound/support-page evidence available if the reviewer requests it.

teamEvidencePacket.reviewerWording: GCA publishes project responsibilities, official channels, and supporting evidence through its official domain.

teamTransparency.ownerActionRequired: Include https://gcagochina.com/team.html in the next BaseScan submission. If BaseScan specifically requests external organization evidence, publish an official organization profile on a recognized business network.

remediationChecklist.evidence: The public site is available at https://gcagochina.com/ and public checks validate the readable site, sitemap, robots, logo, and core pages.

Readable project profile, BaseScan return-reason map, start page, whitepaper, product spec, trust center, and status pages are published at https://gcagochina.com/project-profile.html#basescanMapTitle.

tools/check_site_links.py traverses every public HTML link and resource reference, validates local files and fragments, rejects placeholders and duplicate IDs, and checks all discovered same-origin targets after deployment. tools/check_public_site.py separately validates published identity, content, the current GCA/USDT route, and raw JSON routing.
GCA operating roles and responsibilities are published at https://gcagochina.com/team.html with official project channels and supporting evidence links.

The published primary email is support@gcagochina.com. Zoho Mail is configured for the domain, public DNS records pass MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC checks, inbound and outbound tests are archived privately, and the public evidence checklist remains available at https://gcagochina.com/domain-email-evidence.html.
Official Telegram, X, project profile, support, whitepaper, brand kit, and website URLs are available as full URLs.

requiredBeforeReady: Use support@gcagochina.com as the official BaseScan project email.
Keep the public domain email evidence checklist available at https://gcagochina.com/domain-email-evidence.html and retain private mailbox evidence for reviewer follow-up.
Include the Project Profile BaseScan reviewer map https://gcagochina.com/project-profile.html#basescanMapTitle in the next BaseScan submission.
Include the published GCA team responsibilities URL https://gcagochina.com/team.html in the next BaseScan submission.
Run python3 tools/check_basescan_resubmission_readiness.py --json --require-ready and proceed only when readyForBaseScanResubmission is true.
Use the updated BaseScan reply template at https://gcagochina.com/platform-replies.html and include the project profile, team page, start page, support page, and whitepaper.
